title: Clarity?
symptom: User cannot get the Dexcom Clarity login option in xDrip+ to work; it keeps asking for a 10 digit serial number.
cause: The 10 digit number is from the receiver and is for uploading to Dexcom Share, not Clarity. There is no way to upload xDrip+ to Clarity.
fix: No fix provided; the thread indicates that Clarity integration is not available and would be difficult due to Dexcom locking it down.
evidence_quote: The ten character number is from your receiver. This will allow you to upload to Dexcom Share. However, at this point there is no way to upload xDrip+ to Clarity.
